title: Alignment Data Map for Efficient Preference Data Selection and Diagnosis
authors_zh: Seohyeong Lee, Eunwon Kim, Hwaran Lee, Buru Chang（西江大学、Upstage、高丽大学）
paper_type_zh: 偏好数据选择与标注诊断研究
best_for_zh: 适合在 DPO 或 SimPO 前选择或审计偏好数据、且不满足于只看奖励间隔的读者。
one_line: Alignment Data Map selects preference records by jointly measuring response quality and within-prompt variability, while exposing likely label mismatches.
Alignment Data Map 联合衡量回答质量与同题候选波动，选择更有效的偏好记录并暴露可能错标的样本。
why: It makes absolute response quality and ambiguity jointly visible before a preference record is sent to training.
inclusion_reason: It directly selects which preference records are used for optimization and diagnoses labels that disagree with the scoring evidence used for that decision.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Preference-data selection often uses a reward margin: pairs whose candidate scores are close are treated as informative, while pairs with a large gap are treated as easy. That signal cannot distinguish two low-margin records in which both responses are excellent from two in which both are poor. It also gives no direct way to identify whether a collected preference label agrees with the quality evidence available for its candidates.

Alignment Data Map asks which preference records should be sent to optimization when both absolute response quality and the ambiguity among responses matter. It maps each instruction and its candidate set by mean alignment score and score variability, then uses the map for selection and label diagnosis. The paper changes a record-selection decision before DPO or SimPO training; it is not a new preference loss or a general-purpose benchmark.

偏好数据选择常使用奖励间隔：候选分数相近的回答对被视为信息量大，分数差距大的回答对被视为容易。该信号无法区分两种低间隔记录：一种是两个回答都很优秀，另一种是两个回答都很差。它也不能直接识别已收集的偏好标签是否与候选回答可获得的质量证据一致。

Alignment Data Map 询问：当绝对回答质量和候选间歧义都重要时，哪些偏好记录应被送入优化。它按平均对齐分数和分数波动映射每个指令及其候选集，再将该图用于选择和标签诊断。论文改变的是 DPO 或 SimPO 训练之前的记录选择决策；它不是新的偏好损失或通用基准。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The map represents response quality by the mean alignment score of a prompt's candidates and ambiguity by the variance of those scores. Alignment scores may come from an LLM judge, a reward model, or similarity to a strong reference answer. Low variance generalizes the familiar small-margin condition, while the mean separates genuinely good supervision from uniformly weak candidate sets.

The preferred region is high average quality and low variability. The paper calls it High Average and selects it after first removing the high-variability portion; it also uses the cosine correlation between collected labels and response scores to flag suspicious annotations. Thus the same representation controls two practical decisions: which unlabeled records deserve labeling or training, and which labeled records deserve review.

该图把回答质量表示为一个提示下候选回答的平均对齐分数，把歧义表示为这些分数的方差。对齐分数可来自大模型评判器、奖励模型或与高质量参考答案的相似度。低方差概括了熟悉的小间隔条件，而平均值则把真正优质的监督与整体较弱的候选集区分开来。

被优先选择的区域是平均质量高且波动低的区域。论文将其称为高平均区域，先移除高波动部分后再选择该区域；它还使用已收集标签与回答分数之间的余弦相关性标记可疑标注。因此，同一种表示控制两项实际决策：哪些未标注记录值得标注或训练，以及哪些已标注记录值得复查。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each record containing an instruction and two or more responses, the method obtains a response-level alignment score. It takes the mean as quality and the variance as variability. To form three non-overlapping regions, it assigns the highest-variability 33% to High Variance, then divides the remaining records by quality into Low Average and High Average. For a labeled record, it additionally compares the label vector with the score vector through cosine similarity.

The experiments select 33% subsets from UltraFeedback and Preference-Dissection, train Mistral-7B and LLaMA-3-8B with DPO or SimPO, and evaluate MT-Bench, Evol-Instruct, and AlpacaEval. They repeat selection with GPT-4 labels, ArmoRM scores, and GPT-4o-reference similarity. Reproduction requires the scoring model or reference, response set, region thresholds, label encoding, dataset revision, training hyperparameters, and evaluator versions; changing any score source changes the map and therefore the training data.

对于每条包含一个指令和两个或更多回答的记录，方法先获得回答级对齐分数，再把均值作为质量、方差作为波动。为形成三个互不重叠的区域，它把波动最高的 33% 分到高波动区域，然后按质量把剩余记录划分为低平均和高平均区域。对于有标签记录，它还通过余弦相似度比较标签向量与分数向量。

实验从 UltraFeedback 和 Preference-Dissection 选择 33% 子集，用 DPO 或 SimPO 训练 Mistral-7B 与 LLaMA-3-8B，并在 MT-Bench、Evol-Instruct 和 AlpacaEval 上评测。它以 GPT-4 标签、ArmoRM 分数和 GPT-4o 参考相似度重复选择。复现需要评分模型或参考答案、回答集、区域阈值、标签编码、数据集版本、训练超参数和评判器版本；改变任一评分来源都会改变该图，也会改变训练数据。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
With LLaMA-3-8B and SimPO on UltraFeedback, the 33% High Average subset reports an AlpacaEval win rate of 25.24%, compared with 17.54% for full-data training, 4.90% for a random 33% subset, and 4.23% for the High Variance region. The same subset attains 50.9% MT-Bench win rate and 47.9% Evol-Instruct win rate, providing a concrete example that selection by both quality and variability can outperform data volume in this setting.

The paper also checks the selection criterion across three scoring methods and reports that the High Average region remains best among compared regions. Its label-diagnosis experiment finds that high label-score correlation subsets generally train better than low-correlation subsets; a qualitative example shows an exact answer receiving a lower original label score than irrelevant responses but the highest alignment score. This supports diagnosis as a targeted review signal, not proof that the scoring source is itself a ground-truth annotator.

在 UltraFeedback 上使用 LLaMA-3-8B 和 SimPO 时，33% 的高平均子集报告 AlpacaEval 胜率为 25.24%，而全量训练为 17.54%，随机 33% 子集为 4.90%，高波动区域为 4.23%。同一子集还获得 50.9% 的 MT-Bench 胜率和 47.9% 的 Evol-Instruct 胜率，具体表明在这一设置中，同时依据质量和波动选择可以优于单纯增加数据量。

论文还在三种评分方法下检查选择标准，并报告高平均区域始终在比较的区域中表现最好。其标签诊断实验发现，高标签—分数相关子集通常比低相关子集训练得更好；一个定性例子显示，精确答案得到的原始标签分数低于无关回答，却得到最高对齐分数。这支持把诊断作为定向复查信号，而不证明评分来源本身就是真实标注者。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior selection rules commonly rely on a pairwise margin or on response quality alone. Alignment Data Map changes the selection object into a two-dimensional record characterization: variability captures how difficult a preference comparison is, and average quality captures whether the candidates are worth learning from. The label-score correlation extends the same scored record into a diagnostic surface rather than treating selection and annotation review as separate pipelines.

The contribution is not a new human-feedback dataset, a new judge, or a new DPO objective. Its distinctive reusable artifact is the decision rule that locates a record before training and makes the scoring provenance part of that decision. Before reuse, compare against quality-only and variability-only selections, audit cases that the score source flags as low correlation, and check whether the preferred region underrepresents difficult prompts, languages, or safety-critical behavior.

既有选择规则通常只依赖成对间隔，或只依赖回答质量。Alignment Data Map 将选择对象变为二维记录刻画：波动描述偏好比较有多难，平均质量描述候选是否值得学习。标签—分数相关性又把同一条已评分记录延伸为诊断面，而不把选择和标注复查当作两个分离流程。

贡献不是新的人工反馈数据集、新评判器或新的 DPO 目标。其独特且可复用的产物是训练前定位记录的决策规则，并把评分谱系作为该决策的一部分。复用前，应与仅质量和仅波动选择比较，审计评分来源标记为低相关的案例，并检查优选区域是否代表不足困难提示、语言或安全关键行为。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The map inherits bias and error from the LLM judge, reward model, or reference answer used to score responses, and its reported evaluations rely largely on automatic and LLM-based metrics. Its region boundaries are design choices, while a low label-score correlation can indicate annotation noise but can also expose a scoring model's blind spot. The paper evaluates selected subsets in the reported alignment datasets and benchmarks, so a new use should add human spot checks, subgroup coverage checks, and tests for whether selection removes rare but important preference cases.
该图会继承用于给回答评分的大模型评判器、奖励模型或参考答案的偏差与错误，报告中的评测也主要依赖自动指标和大模型指标。区域边界是设计选择，而低标签—分数相关可能表示标注噪声，也可能暴露评分模型的盲点。论文在报告的对齐数据集和基准中评测所选子集，因此新的使用应加入人工抽查、子群覆盖检查，以及选择是否移除了罕见但重要偏好情形的测试。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a preference collection has multiple candidate responses per prompt or when a large labeled corpus is too costly to train on wholesale. Compute and retain the individual scores, mean, variance, region assignment, correlation, scorer identity, and thresholds alongside the original record; these are necessary to explain a selection decision or reconsider it when the judge changes. It is useful for prioritizing annotation and training, but it should not be used as an automatic deletion rule without checking whether low-score regions contain valuable edge cases.
当偏好收集为每个提示提供多个候选回答，或大型已标注语料的全量训练成本过高时，可使用这篇论文。应将各个分数、均值、方差、区域归属、相关性、评分器身份和阈值与原始记录一同保存；当评判器变化时，它们是解释选择决策或重新考虑该决策所必需的。它适合为标注和训练排序，但在检查低分区域是否包含有价值边缘案例之前，不应将其用作自动删除规则。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The key distinction is that low variability alone is not enough: a difficult comparison among poor answers is different from a difficult comparison among good answers. Alignment Data Map makes this distinction observable and uses it before training, then reuses the same scores to find label disagreements. The 33% High Average result is a strong efficiency signal in the reported setting, but the map is only as trustworthy as its scorer and its coverage of the task distribution.
关键区别是，仅有低波动还不够：差回答之间的困难比较不同于好回答之间的困难比较。Alignment Data Map 让这种区别可见，并在训练前使用它，再复用同一组分数寻找标签分歧。报告中的 33% 高平均结果是在该设置下很强的效率信号，但该图只会和其评分器及任务分布覆盖程度一样可靠。
